stemMd: A ray turns clockwise through 125 degrees and then counterclockwise through 47 degrees. What is its net clockwise turn?
explanationMd: Treat clockwise as positive and counterclockwise as negative. The net turn is 125−47=78 degrees clockwise.

distractorRationale.a: This is the equivalent opposite-direction full-turn complement, not the requested net clockwise amount.
